reserveReview.rationale: The eleven categories reproduce the dollar amounts in the September 30, 2026 report, signed October 30, 2026. Percentages are derived from the report's total assets and rounded to six decimals. Both authored composition arrays use this same dated allocation. The live transparency endpoint supplies circulation and a live reserve residual, not the report-dated issuer balance sheet, and does not refresh composition. Primary-source re-verification was completed at 2026-11-01; the report's page 4 table gives U.S. Treasury Bills 122839738995, Overnight Reverse Repurchase Agreements 9518706336, Term Reverse Repurchase Agreements 7177537907, Non-US Treasury Bills 21981521, Cash & Bank Deposits 20427407, Corporate Bonds 63881392, Precious Metals 19084651736, Bitcoin 8367170264, Public Equities 4177803686, Other Investments 6004074506 and Secured Loans 14175117624, totaling 191451091374. The report covers fiat-denominated Tether tokens, not an independently allocated USDT-only balance sheet. Verified confidence covers the sourced amounts, dates and explicit category descriptions, not unresolved look-through identities. The non-US sovereign and corporate legacy risk tiers are conservative editorial classifications, not attested ratings. Report page 4 footnote 10 states that Precious Metals comprises 'LBMA standard physical gold bars owned by the Company'. This establishes directly owned physical gold, but the D2 commodity peg-match rule reserves commodity-allocated for tokens pegged to the vaulted metal (GOLD or SILVER). USDT is USD-pegged, so its gold retains USD gold-price exposure and cannot receive that class's quality-90 and maturity-N/A treatment. The current reserve asset-class vocabulary has no separate physical-commodity class for USD-pegged reserves; retain other with market, custody and liquidity risk factors. No custodian identity, bar-level segregation, bankruptcy priority or liquidity term is inferred. Footnote 5 states Overnight Reverse-Repurchase Agreements have 'a maturity of 1 day' and are fully collateralized by US Treasuries: restore only this category's one-day contractual horizon and retain maturityDaysMax=1. This is the stated contractual term, not guaranteed stressed settlement. Footnotes 4, 6 and 7 give weighted/residual average maturities for US bills, term repo and non-US bills; footnote 9 gives corporate bonds' residual average above 360 days. None establishes a category-wide maximum or realization deadline. Footnote 8 identifies deposits without an access term; footnotes 10-14 identify physical gold, on-chain bitcoin, actively traded equities, other investments and secured loans without a category-wide liquidity term. All other liquidity horizons remain unknown after this researched disclosure review. No averages are converted to maxima; compositionAsOf stays 2026-09-30. The liveReservesConfig.params.slices classifications mirror these reviewed fields and change its fingerprint; existing mismatched snapshots remain inadmissible until recovery produces a compatible snapshot.
reserveReview.compositionBasis: BDO-assured Tether International reserves for fiat-denominated tokens at 2026-09-30 23:59 UTC; eleven reported USD asset categories divided by total assets of USD 191451091374.
reserveReview.knownUnknownExposure: The selected unresolved look-through set comprises non-US Treasury bills, corporate bonds, public equities, other investments and secured loans: the report does not identify their sovereign or corporate issuers, borrowers, positions or concentration. Its USD 24442858729 aggregate is 12.767156% of reported total assets when rounded to six decimals; the individually rounded slice percentages also sum to 12.767156%. This set is not all counterparty uncertainty; banking and repo counterparties also remain unnamed.

custodyProfile.uncertainty: The Q3 2026 BDO report identifies reserve asset categories in aggregate and names no custodians; its procedures obtained confirmations directly from banks and depositaries. The CNAD-filed Relevant Information Document (2026-02-20), Safeguarding Arrangements section, states reserves are held with various third parties including banks and licensed financial institutions, without identifying those providers or describing reserve segregation, bankruptcy-remoteness, or reuse restrictions. The Token Terms grant verified customers a personal contractual redemption right. These inspected sources do not establish provider shares or the three custody safeguards; their unknown status is retained. This review does not claim that no other public source names a custodian.
